messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — holiday paid push plan. Need a concise play: search bid pacing, retarget creative rotation, and inbound lead routing update. Goal = keep CPA +/-10% vs baseline and avoid traffic cliffs over long weekends. :christmas_tree:

Tom: are we lowering bids across the board or only for low-intent queries?

Elaine: only non-branded, low-intent keywords. keep branded + exact match as-is. propose -15% weekend reduction for broad/phrase.

Ravi: pinging the ops checklist — I can wire the webhook for inbound leads to the new route (/webhooks/marketing/holiday). who owns lead schema validation?

Jules: I will handle schema. please send sample payloads. also we should add utm_source=paid_holiday and utm_campaign=holiday23_search to tracking.

Elaine: sample payload (for schema):
```
{
  "lead_id": "12345",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "source": "paid_search",
  "campaign": "holiday23_search",
  "score": 0.72
}
```

Tom: re bids — can we keep a safety cap so our automated script never drops below 60% of current bids? we tripped underpacing last year and lost impression share.

Elaine: good call. cap = max(60% of current, floor bid $0.50). I'll add that to the spreadsheet and the API script.

ads-bot: Campaign "Holiday Spark - Search" (id: 78912) started. budget: $8,000/day.

Ravi: I switched inbound route to /webhooks/marketing/holiday in staging. test webhook result: 200 OK, payload validated, forwarded to leads-service.

Jules: tested sample payloads in staging, mapping to CRM fields looks good. small note: 'score' currently is float, CRM expects string. will cast on ingest unless we change schema.

Elaine: leave casting in ingest for now. point action items:
- Elaine: update bids sheet + publish weekend pacing rules (sheet link: https://go.redwood/holiday-pacing)
- Tom: build safety-cap into bidding script and run dry-run today
- Ravi: flip webhook to prod after Tom's dry-run confirms no surprises
- Jules: update CRM mapping for score casting

Tom: I'll run dry-run at 10:30 PT and post results here. :thumbsup:

ads-bot: Dry-run scheduled by Tom for campaign id 78912 at 2026-12-10T18:30:00Z (simulation mode).

Elaine: thanks team — we'll reconvene after dry-run and decide on creative swap cadence (thinking AB every 48 hours). :eyes:
